Minako Kotobuki (Japanese: 寿美菜子 Kotobuki Minako) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Kotobuki was born on September 17, 1991, in , , . At the age of three, she and her parents survived the devastating . Sometime afterwards, she watched a film titled Chikyuu ga Ugoita Hi ("The Day the Earth Moved"), which inspired her to become a voice actress. As an adult, Kotobuki led a successful voice acting career since 2005 and even became a well-known singer as well. She joined the during , most notably voicing , a recurring character. She is currently affiliated with Music Ray'n and a member of the idol group .
